top_band: wooden frame and yellow woven mat with blue fish from row 1 to row 17 (with front beam top highlight at row 17)
evidence: The drying rack has a large foreshortened top surface (rows 1-17) showing the wooden frame and woven mat with fish lying on top. Row 17 is the lighter front edge of the horizontal beam, followed by the front face of the beam (rows 18-19), under-beam shadow (row 20), and recessed front/back legs (rows 20-24).

style.evidence: The piece uses 5 distinct tones on the wood and woven mat, plus 4 tones on the small fish. Outlines are dark brown matching the wood material, the woven mat has vertical grain striping and gradual right-side shading, and the overall detail matches the Beodeul reference props.
